notes: Borough accepted DCA's Present Need of 114 and Fourth Round prospective need of 99 (Resolution #69, January 23, 2025). Fourth Round RDP = 0 (not adjusted; full 99-unit obligation to be met). Third Round: RDP=30 adjusted (originally 0 per COAH VLA), Unmet Need=152. Fourth Round mechanisms: 75&87 Bergen Turnpike (65 total / 13 affordable, 20%, proposed); 21 Main Street (135 total / 27 affordable, 20%, proposed); Regan Development/Osprey Point (31 credits from 85-unit 100% affordable, completed); 220&230 US Route 46 (86 total / 13 affordable, 15%, approved June 12, 2024); + 25 redevelopment bonus credits. Total: 75 affordable + 25 bonus = 100 credits (exceeds 99). Updated Mandatory Set-Aside ordinance (20% for 5+ units). Block/lots NOT stated in HEFSP for 75&87 Bergen Turnpike and 21 Main St.

sites.site_name: Osprey Point Apartments (250 Mehrhof Road) — Regan Development Corp
sites.quote: Regan Development Corp. Block 107, Lots 2.01 and 17; Block 106.01, Lot 13.06 (20 of 85 units; 31 to future) 20 100% Affordable Age Restricted Rental Completed... Regan Development Corp constructed the Osprey Point Apartments at 250 Mehrhof Road. This project comprises of 85 units, which are 100% affordable including 62 age-restricted units and 23 special-needs units. Fifty-four of the units were credited towards the Third Round RDP and Unmet Need, leaving 31 credits to apply towards the Fourth Round Prospective Need.
sites.notes: 85 total units 100% affordable (62 age-restricted + 23 special-needs). 54 credits applied to Third Round; 31 remaining applied to Fourth Round. Completed and occupied.

sites.quote: The Borough will adopt an updated ordinance requiring a mandatory affordable housing set aside for all new single-family attached and multifamily residential development of 5 units or more. Both rental and for-sale developments will be required to implement a 20% set aside.
sites.notes: Borough-wide mandatory set-aside. No specific block/lot — borough-wide.

sites.adoption_status: program active (Bergen County Housing Rehabilitation Program)
sites.quote: Little Ferry was assigned a Present Need (Rehabilitation) Obligation of one hundred fourteen (114) affordable units. The Borough will be conducting a structural conditions survey to determine an on-the-ground estimate of the units in need of rehabilitation. The Borough established a housing rehabilitation program under the Third-Round cycle and will continue its program into the Fourth Round and partner with the Bergen County Housing Rehabilitation Program.
sites.notes: Present Need (rehabilitation) obligation = 114 units. Partners with Bergen County Housing Rehabilitation Program.
